groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.668% and the 10Y at 4.914%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -1.62% over five sessions and -4.05% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.55% at about $88.88, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-18/100, 60% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, supportive options positioning, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
